result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the three prior open findings and directly touched Story 7 production/test surfaces: PI runtime target-aware capture, `/lh-fixture pi-session` active-branch behavior, and PI-session fixture cwd fidelity. I also reran the configured story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `ensureActiveThread()` now derives the current target and reuses `activeThread` only when `targetsMatch(activeThread.target, target)` is true; otherwise it opens or creates the managed Thread for the current target (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts`). Regression test `production PI handlers resolve a fresh managed thread when the PI session target changes` asserts two session targets produce distinct thread ids and isolated session metadata. `npm run verify` and `npm run verify-all` both passed.

`executeFixtureCommand()` now passes `activeLeafId: activeLeafIdFromContext(input.ctx)` and `sessionManager: importSessionManagerFromContext(input.ctx)` into `createRealSessionFixture()` for PI-session fixture creation (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts`). `readPiActivePath()` already resolves the provided active leaf through the session manager/file path. Regression test `/lh-fixture pi-session imports the active branch from the live session manager` asserts fixture messages come from `entry-001`, `branch-entry-001`, and `branch-entry-002`, excluding the inactive main branch response. Gates passed.

`fixture-service` no longer sets `cwd` to `dirname(sessionFilePath)` when creating the temporary imported thread. `readPiActivePath()` now exposes `cwd: manager.value.getCwd?.()`, and `attachExistingPiSession()` fills target cwd from the import plan when the caller did not provide one (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-session-importer.ts`, `src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts`, `src/context-steward/services/fixture-service.ts`). Regression coverage asserts fixture `thread.json` target cwd equals the source session cwd and differs from the session file directory.

additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed with 104 unit tests.
`npm run verify-all` passed; the integration runner still reports `No integration tests found.`, matching the prior observation, but the configured epic gate exited successfully.
No material fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real runtime path was found in the followed-up Story 7 production changes. Test fakes remain confined to tests.
